B ⇒ A holds only outright (B unused): A's conjuncts are stated for an ARBITRARY sc-isomorphism T and point e, not a presentation of some C ∋ e; convexity of C_e is not in B; and minimalSubspaceWith_le/_eq (E_x does not depend on the presentation, the sign argument of Lemma 1.24) is not stated by B, which asserts its claims for each presentation separately. The text defines C_e, E_e intrinsically via the extended faces, so independence is implicit there, but B does not capture it. No universe parameters.
